purpose: Read-only upstream behavior reference for native Go tests; not an application runtime dependency.

behavior_references.note: pattern is optional; inputMode=numeric is a keyboard hint, not a character filter.
Only a changed value from an incomplete previous value to maxLength completes; initial full values and full-to-full edits do not.
Transform clipboard text, replace selected range, truncate, gate by pattern, then notify change.
Selection moves to the final slot/end after transformed paste, including paste into the middle.

native_differences: Lengths and selection use the native MyGo rune indices rather than JavaScript UTF-16 code-unit indices.
Native slot construction has a private limit of 4096; invalid counts and non-finite derived bounds expose Invalid with finite fallback geometry.
DOM password-manager badges, browser autofill/no-script CSS, and browser-specific iOS paste adapters are not native desktop features.
A PasteTransform that turns an empty clipboard into non-empty content follows the source value/selection contract, but MyGo creates no native paste undo transaction for an empty raw clipboard.
